_comment: Default bindings for Prince of Persia: the keyboard as the DOS game has it - the arrows, Shift, Enter, and each command and cheat on the game's own key -
except Restart Game, whose Ctrl+R is Chimera's Reboot Core (no key; bind one); the time cheats are on the keypad's - and +, as in the game.
Ctrl+B, R and Shift+S are also TAStudio's own keys while its window has the focus.
The first pad: the d-pad and left stick as the arrows, A as Shift, Start as Enter, Back as Restart Level.

Prince of Persia.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
Prince of Persia.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Prince of Persia.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Prince of Persia.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
Prince of Persia.P1 Shift: Shift, LeftShift, RightShift, J1 B1, X1 A
